verdict.rationale: Greptile documents pairing static scanning with an AI security agent to catch vulnerabilities in every pull request. It also offers dependency vulnerability checks (SCA), and its general reviews catch functional bugs, so security findings sit alongside bug findings. However, the evidence never names the specific classes in the story, and there is no hands-on corroboration of security catches. Missing for 10: documented detection of injection risks, leaked or hard-coded secrets, and insecure code patterns; independent or hands-on evidence of security findings in real reviews.

support.subject: As a security engineer, reviews flag security problems in the diff — injection risks, leaked secrets, insecure patterns — alongside functional bugs
